text:
anna: quick heads-up, release CI for the sdk publish is red; regen diff shows a param reorder in the Go SDK that triggered a semver minor bump check
ci-bot: publish-gate: regen-diff detected (PR #7891) — blocking publish, see artifacts at https://ci.internal/reports/7891
sam: ugh. that looks like the stable-sort change from yesterday's typegen tweak — ordering changed even when surface is semantically identical
julia: can we treat param reordering as a non-breaking change in these cases? otherwise every harmless sort tweak forces a minor bump and noisy changelogs
own: we should be careful. some reorderings do break positional-arg callers. but for SDKs that are fully named-arg (like Go with option structs) it should be fine
anna: in this case the regen diff is solely in the generated function signature param list ordering. no code paths changed. I ran a quick grep in sampleapp tests — they still compile
sam: two options: revert the typegen change now (fast), or add a deterministic stable-sort and regen to normalize (slower but correct). either way we need a CI policy for these diffs
julia: +1 on stable-sort + unit test. also propose a CI label that turns 'minor-bump' into 'manual-review-required' for param-order-only diffs
own: I'll draft the sorter patch. quick snippet I used locally:
```
# in typegen/sorters.go
sort.SliceStable(params, func(i, j int) bool {
  if params[i].Name == params[j].Name { return params[i].OriginalIndex < params[j].OriginalIndex }
  return params[i].Name < params[j].Name
})
```
anna: nice. can you also add a golden-file unit test to catch nondeterministic ordering? that should stop this flake from reappearing
sam: in the meantime, release-bot: can we convert the current publish block into a manual hold rather than auto-fail? some teams will want to push a patch without a semver bump if it's safe
release-bot: publish-gate: current policy = fail on regen-diff that affects public API. I'll create a follow-up ticket to add param-order semantic classifier and manual override flow (TICKET-4321)
julia: can we also improve the regen diff output to highlight "only ordering changes" so reviewers don't scroll forever
anna: plan: owen -> PR with stable-sort + golden test by EOD, julia -> CI gating proposal, sam -> revert PR if ship needs to go out sooner
anna: assigning: @owen on the patch, @julia on CI proposal, @sam will monitor the hotfix path and decide on revert if needed :thumbsup:
sam: ack. I'll monitor today's release queue and call revert if any downstream breakups appear
own: starting work now, will post draft PR link in this thread
ci-bot: update: new artifact uploaded for branch/owen/typegen-stable-sort (regendiff now empty)
anna: awesome — if CI stays green let's cut a tiny patch release and update changelog with a short note: "typegen: stable param ordering, no behavior change"
julia: and doc the manual-review override flow in release playbook so release engineers can unblock without guessing
anna: thanks all, keeping this thread as the coordination thread.
